articles.summary: Strong loan and deposit growth and operating efficiency drive tangible book value expansion HAMILTON, N.J., July 23, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - First Bank (Nasdaq Global Market: FRBA) ("the Bank") today announced results for the second quarter of 2026. Net income for the second quarter of 2026 was $10.9 million, or $0.43 per diluted share, compared to $10.2 million, or $0.41 per diluted share, for the second quarter of 2025.
